snippet.title: The Lord of the Rings: Return to Moria™ - Durin's Folk Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
⛰️ Moria will be filled with Dwarves again! ⛰️

Grab your gear because we have work to do! NPCs have arrived and with them a new chapter of the story! Up to 20h of new gameplay, trading mechanics, new locations, replayable expeditions inside other mountains, and of course, recruitable NPCs.

Be brave, be bold and be vigilant! For not everyone is who they seem to be…

🔥 Durin’s Folk Story Expansion is Out Now! 🔥

GET IT HERE:
Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3874660/The_Lord_of_the_Rings_Return_to_Moria_Durins_Folk_Expansion/
Epic: https://store.epicgames.com/en-US/p/the-lord-of-the-rings-return-to-moria-the-lord-of-the-rings-return-to-moria-durins-folk-8bd214
